interpretation_limits: The frozen endpoint files represent a rolling last-24-hour view, not a long historical archive.
The active spacecraft changes during the sample; spacecraft identity remains visible in every paired row.
The measurements are upstream of Earth. No propagation delay is applied when they are compared with daily geomagnetic context.
The paired records are a descriptive compilation, not a causal analysis, storm forecast, or instrument validation.
Daily summaries cover only the sampled minutes and are explicitly marked partial when they do not contain all 1,440 UTC minutes.
Estimated planetary Kp is a separate three-hour/day product and is included only as completed daily context.
Missing input values remain null; source quality fields are preserved without a new interpretation.

method.daily_grouping: The source time-tag date prefix; report coverage out of 1,440 minutes and preserve partial days
method.kp_context: Show only complete daily Kp summaries; do not time-shift or interpret as simultaneous causal response
method.pairing: Exact match on source and unchanged time_tag
method.selection: active must be the JSON boolean true

reuse_notes: Raw all-spacecraft records are preserved separately from active-selected views.
Keep measured upstream plasma and field values distinct from estimated Kp and daily derived summaries.
The one-day capture is a small teaching and exploration sample, not a long historical study.
summary: The dated snapshots contain 3247 plasma and 3432 magnetometer records; 1031 rows pair the selected active spacecraft on exact source and time-tag matches.
topic: NOAA real-time solar-wind plasma and IMF measurements
